review_type: single AI curator; full received final answer read; model identity visible

errors.quote: Convert luminescence to [ATP](t) via the calibration curve
errors.issue: The continuous reporter consumes ATP. A bolus intensity calibration and ATP-accumulation slope do not identify synthesis flux without reporter-consumption and impulse-response calibration or an independent reporter-free sampling arm. Lag quantification alone does not repair the material balance.

errors.quote: Each arm is a sealed chamber run under identical temperature, buffer lot, bead lot, and timing:
errors.issue: The listed arms lack separate ADP- and phosphate-omission tests, despite claiming ATP formation from both substrates. Ap5A and general blanks do not establish phosphate dependence or exclude every ATP-forming contaminant.

errors.quote: No contamination or drift mechanism plausibly tracks this schedule.
errors.issue: Direction-correlated field/optical effects, assay carryover and mechanically gated release can track a drive schedule. The controls narrow alternatives but do not make schedule locking logically artifact-proof.

errors.quote: measure the fraction of beads that follow the field without slipping
errors.issue: Actual turns are valuable but do not quantify torque or mechanical work at gamma. The protocol lacks an operational torque-field/drag/compliance calibration even though it claims controlled mechanical input.

errors.quote: A direction-specific, rotation-number-proportional, enzyme-dependent accumulation of ATP
errors.issue: Finite prebound ATP is not measured or explicitly bounded. Require continued output beyond a measured starting pool or equivalent substrate-provenance/turnover evidence; directionality alone does not exclude mechanically gated release.

rationale: Correct reverse-operation question and useful field, dead-enzyme and reporter controls. Quantitative reporter kinetics, substrate-omission controls, initial bound-pool accounting and delivered-work calibration are missing. These are substantial gaps in the requested discrimination. A full historical hit requires all five predefined components, not just naming reverse rotation.
reference_guardrails: The packet establishes ATP-associated directional motion, not an ATP-per-turn yield, torque, universal camera sign or completed reverse-synthesis experiment. Proposed numerical settings may earn credit when explicitly qualified.
Correct the draft reference by explicitly requiring magnesium/cofactor and nucleotide speciation qualification; its generic reaction inventory is not a complete buffer recipe.
Reverse operation should generate new ATP repeatedly beyond measured initial available/bound pools. Three catalytic sites are not a universal total ATP-contamination bound.

Luciferase is an acceptable chemical readout when its consumption, recovery and time response are calibrated. An intensity slope is not generally synthesis flux; chromatographic detection is an alternative, not mandatory.
Label incorporation can reflect exchange. Pair isotope provenance with net-product/material balance; account for reporter consumption and sample removal as appropriate.
Empirical direction, mixed surface orientations, actual rotor turns and transmitted torque are distinct quantities. Do not replace any with the nominal actuator command.

Mechanical input can drive ATP synthesis uphill. Low initial ATP may aid sensitivity but does not prove positive chemical-energy storage; energetic efficiency needs both work and chemical free energy.

ATP per turn is a coupling yield, not energetic efficiency. Inactive fractions, orientation, incomplete entrainment and analytical recovery can reduce apparent yield without establishing loose molecular coupling.
Separate ADP and phosphate controls help discriminate intended synthesis from alternative ATP production. Inhibitor effects require assay and enzyme specificity validation.

Matching is retrospective and applies all five predeclared components. A partially correct historical direction is recorded even when the experimental design is flawed; no claim of prospective novelty or uncontaminated holdout is made.
